page.layout: One page of text, with no margin notes. Running head top left, page number top right. Title block centred at top, then three numbered sections in one column.

main_text.l: bene ducinon patiantur. Et quod mirum est,
Scripturæ quæ iuvant eos qui per fidem valet,
officiunt istis qui circa quæstiones ac inutiles
ut fidem, sed ut infidelitatem inveniât. Basilius
Curiosa istorum hominum circa syllabas ac
alicui videri possit, neq; ad mediocre tendens
malum: sed profundum atq; obtectum habet
adversus pietatem consilium. Idem, de Sp.
ne sumptas ad simplicem artificii ignaram do-

page.notes: Title is set in capitals with hyphens at the line ends. Long s in "istorum" and "Sophisticen" read as plain s. "5" after "lib." is doubtful [?] in the scan, though it reads as 5. "ducinon" is printed without a space and is left as printed. Abbreviations neq; and atq; are kept as printed.
